user.title: Hargassner boiler
user.description: Modbus TCP interface of the Hargassner Loxone extension. Setup only reads; writing HC2 stays off until you enable it.

data_description.host: IP of the boiler or modbus proxy

error.cannot_connect: No connection. Check IP address and port. With modbus-proxy this is the port the proxy listens on, not the boiler's 502. Details: {details}
error.no_response: Connected but no answer. Check the unit address and whether the proxy reaches the boiler. Details: {details}
error.modbus_exception: The boiler rejects the request. Details: {details}

data.room_gain: Raise per K room too cold

data_description.word_swap: Detected during setup. Only change if temperatures look wrong.
data_description.heat_limit: From this averaged outdoor temperature only the minimum flow is requested.
data_description.room_gain: If the coldest room is 1 K below target, the flow rises by this value. If all rooms are above target, it drops accordingly.

data_description.rooms: Thermostats of the rooms on this circuit. Add or remove any time.
data_description.max: Never written higher, not even by the automatic mode.
data_description.out_cold: Linear between the two points, extended beyond them.
data_description.register: Default 6999 as in Hargassner's Loxone template (manual V01 lists 6998). Only change if your boiler is known to use another address.
data_description.request_entities: If any of these is on (or above 0), at least the following flow applies, even above the heating limit.
data_description.shift: The curve follows the highest target of the selected rooms; with all rooms on eco at night the flow drops by itself (about 1 + slope K per K).
data_description.ref_room: The entered curve applies to this room target (21 °C for Hargassner and Loxone).
